content.title: Denver Nuggets at San Antonio Spurs - Where to Watch, Stream Info, TV Channel, and Live Updates (March 12, 2026)
content.text: The Denver Nuggets will face off against the San Antonio Spurs in a highly anticipated matchup. The Nuggets enter the game with a record of 40-26, currently sitting second in their division and riding a one-game winning streak. Leading the team is Nikola Jokić, who averages 28.6 points, 12.5 rebounds, and 10.4 assists per game. On the other hand, the Spurs boast an impressive record of 48-17, placing them first in their division and on a five-game winning streak. Victor Wembanyama leads the Spurs with 24.2 points and 11.1 rebounds per game, although his availability for the game is uncertain due to an ankle injury. This matchup promises to be a critical contest as both teams look to solidify their standings in the league. Harrison Barnes – Ankle (Day To Day) – The Spurs have listed Barnes as Questionable for Thursday’s (Mar. 12) game against the Nuggets. Lindy Waters III – Illness (Day To Day) – The Spurs have listed Waters III as Questionable for Thursday’s (Mar. 12) game against the Nuggets.
